WITH all_films AS (
  SELECT COUNT(fa.actor_id) AS actor_count 
  FROM film f 
  LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON f.film_id = fa.film_id 
  GROUP BY f.film_id
),
avg1 AS (
  SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS val FROM all_films
),
above_avg1 AS (
  SELECT af.actor_count
  FROM all_films af, avg1
  WHERE af.actor_count > avg1.val
),
avg2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS val FROM above_avg1
),
final_films AS (
  SELECT aa.actor_count
  FROM above_avg1 aa, avg2
  WHERE aa.actor_count > avg2.val
)
SELECT 
  SUM(f.actor_count) AS sum_actors,
  AVG(f.actor_count - (SELECT val FROM avg1)) AS excess_over_avg1,
  AVG(f.actor_count - (SELECT val FROM avg2)) AS excess_over_avg2
FROM final_films f
